The builder applies the following default configuration:

- Port: `3050` (see `FirebirdSqlBuilder.FirebirdSqlPort`)
- Environment variable: `FIREBIRD_DATABASE=test` (see `FirebirdSqlBuilder.WithDatabase(string)`)
- Environment variable: `FIREBIRD_USER=test` (see `FirebirdSqlBuilder.WithUsername(string)`)
- Environment variable: `FIREBIRD_PASSWORD=test` (see `FirebirdSqlBuilder.WithPassword(string)`)
- Environment variable: `ISC_PASSWORD=test` (see `FirebirdSqlBuilder.WithPassword(string)`)
- File: `/home/firebird_check.sql`

    ```
    SELECT 1 FROM RDB$DATABASE;
    ```

- Wait strategy: Waits until the container is healthy.
